intro: Dalin's Heart is a macabre ritual component carved from Dalin Forgewright, an honorable man patrolling near the Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest. Undercity warlocks seek it out as an offering of unblemished purity, intended to lure and bind a succubus to their service.

sections.t: A Pure Heart for Dark Arts
p: To summon and subjugate a succubus, Undercity warlocks require rare bait: the physical hearts of truly virtuous mortals. Dalin Forgewright earned his dark fate through selfless devotion, spending his days defending desperate Lordaeron refugees barred from safety at the sealed Greymane Wall. His unstinting altruism marks him as an emblem of goodness in a fallen land, making his heart an irresistible prize for demonic seduction rites conducted within the Temple of the Damned.
